operationSets.name: TicketActions
operationSets.comment:
A ticket's status and timers operations (D103), for callers who hold
tickets.write; a reset or a snooze needs tickets.timers too, which the
core checks.

operations.name: timersFireTimer
operations.comment: Fires a deadline that is due and has not fired: marks it fired and moves the status by its then, recording the outcome; a veto or a missing permission the move meets leaves the status as it is and the deadline fired. A deadline whose until holds is cancelled instead. On a deadline not due, fired already or not started it changes nothing. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; the engine's runner calls it on every due deadline, every sweepMs.

docs.title: Ticket timers: fire timer
docs.description: Fires a deadline that is due and has not fired: marks it fired and moves the status by its then, recording the outcome; a veto or a missing permission the move meets leaves the status as it is and the deadline fired. A deadline whose until holds is cancelled instead. On a deadline not due, fired already or not started it changes nothing. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; the engine's runner calls it on every due deadline, every sweepMs.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: timersResetTimer
operations.comment: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

docs.description: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: timersSnoozeTimer
operations.comment: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.

docs.title: Ticket timers: snooze timer
docs.description: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.
